s1.syndrome_frame: a gradually enlarging cutaneous tumor with a hard nodule
salient_findings: red tumor on the right upper arm
key_facts: 16-year-old girl
tumor enlarged over 6 months
no history of local trauma or insect bite
personal, past, and family histories were unremarkable
6 × 6-cm protuberant, thick-walled, and well-defined red tumor
nontender, firm-to-hard nodule inside the tumor
normal laboratory tests
multilocular spaces below the epidermis on pathological examination
solid tumor in the deep dermis with a chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance
basophilic cells and shadow cells in the deep dermis on histological examination
dilated lymphatic vessels in the dermis above the tumor

shortlist.label: Pilomatrixoma
shortlist.why_kept: matches clinical presentation of a gradually enlarging cutaneous tumor with a hard nodule and histological findings of basophilic cells and shadow cells

shortlist.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
shortlist.why_kept: consistent with the description of a protuberant, thick-walled, and well-defined red tumor

shortlist.label: Cylindroma
shortlist.why_kept: possible match given the tumor's multilocular spaces and solid appearance in the deep dermis

shortlist.label: Spiradenoma
shortlist.why_kept: considered due to the presence of a firm-to-hard nodule and the tumor's location in the dermis

shortlist.label: Plexiform fibrohistiocytic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: plausible due to the tumor's complex appearance and the presence of dilated lymphatic vessels
